name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.9 degrees north of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 21 times in 7 visits over 60 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 40 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.5 days starting 2025-10-31, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 4.20 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
